settings.title: Dimensions
settings.text:
Double: 141cm wide × 196cm long, for a 135 × 190cm mattress.
King: 156cm wide × 206cm long, for a 150 × 200cm mattress.
Super King: for a 180 × 200cm mattress, about 185cm wide × 205cm long.

Height: 35.5cm. Weight capacity: 430kg (Double), 452kg (King and Super King).

settings.title: What’s included
settings.text: The upholstered platform bed frame. Mattress not included.

settings.title: Assembly
settings.text: Easy to assemble, with no tools needed. Works with adjustable bases.

settings.title: Materials
settings.text: Plywood and solid wood frame, high-density foam and your choice of fabric.

settings.title: Care
settings.text: Vintage leather and metallic: wipe with a damp cloth. Velvet, micro suede and weave: vacuum with a soft brush and spot-clean gently.

settings.title: Delivery
settings.text: Free delivery to England, Scotland and Wales. We don’t currently deliver to Northern Ireland. Dispatched the next working day and delivered in 3–5 working days.

settings.title: Returns & warranty
settings.text: 14 days to change your mind. 1-year warranty. See Delivery & returns for how.

settings.title: Colour accuracy
settings.text: Colours can look slightly different on screen. A swatch shows the real shade.
